criteria.text: Patient is being treated for an infection suspected to be S. aureus or S. pyogenes susceptible to mupirocin.
Patient is unable to use mupirocin 2% ointment due to a documented allergy to one or more inactive ingredients present in the ointment formulation that are absent in the cream.

notes: Partial encoding of Alaska Medicaid Bactroban Cream (mupirocin cream) Criteria Version 1; Last updated 3/21/2011; Approved 4/15/2011; Reviewed 09/19/2014 (format & reference update). Stub effective_date 1970-01-01 replaced with approval date 2011-04-15.
FDA indication (notes only): treatment of secondarily infected traumatic skin lesions (up to 10 cm in length or 100 cm² in area) due to susceptible strains of S. aureus and S. pyogenes.
Denial criterion (encoded via the ointment-allergy gate): patient does not have a documented allergy to one or more inactive ingredients present in the ointment formulation.
Reference: Bactroban cream package insert, GlaxoSmithKline, May 2014.

options.label: Secondarily infected traumatic skin lesion due to susceptible S. aureus or S. pyogenes
